name: Kinetic Dampening
effects: Until the beginning of your next turn you have resistance to physical damage equal to 5, +5 at 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter. With the second Awakening, also resistance of the same value to your choice of fire, electricity or sonic (player picks the type).

name: Living Statue
effects: While standing on the earth you have resistance 5 to physical damage except adamantine; this becomes resistance 8 in caves or subterranean environments.

name: Maelstromic Destabilizer (Lesser)
effects: For 1 minute the holder has resistance 2 to spirit damage.

name: Maelstromic Destabilizer (Major)
effects: For 1 minute the holder has resistance 10 to spirit damage.

name: Maelstromic Destabilizer (Moderate)
effects: For 1 minute the holder has resistance 5 to spirit damage.

name: Saurian Spike (Major)
effects: While the spellheart is affixed to armor: gain precise scent with a range of 60 feet.

name: Scouring Spark
effects: Immune to the confused and frightened conditions; unarmed Strikes deal +1d6 fire damage; your fire spells deal one additional damage die of the spell's own die type. (Creatures that touch you taking 3d6 is target-facing.)

name: Shadow Master
toggleName: Shadow Master (in dim light or darkness)
effects: Resistance 5 to all damage except force damage and damage from Strikes with the Ghost Touch property rune; roll Reflex saves twice and take the higher result (fortune).

name: Shadow Sight
effects: For 1 minute (once per hour), gain the greater-darkvision sense.

name: Siccatite Buckler (High-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 10 to the opposing energy type — cold if it is a hot siccatite shield, fire if it is a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Siccatite Buckler (Standard-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 5 to the opposing energy type — cold for a hot siccatite shield, fire for a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Siccatite Shield (High-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 10 to the opposing energy type — cold for a hot siccatite shield, fire for a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Siccatite Shield (Standard-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 5 to the opposing energy type — cold for a hot siccatite shield, fire for a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Spell Survivor
effects: Until the end of that caster's next turn, gain resistance to all damage dealt by the caster whose spell you critically saved against: resistance 1, increasing by 1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter (2 at 9th, 3 at 13th, 4 at 17th).

name: Spiny Lodestone
effects: While affixed to armor: +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and resistance 2 to nonlethal damage.

name: Spiny Lodestone (Greater)
effects: While affixed to armor: +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and resistance 5 to nonlethal damage.

name: Spun Cloud (Blue)
effects: While you are inside the exhaled blue cloud (20-foot burst, lasts 1 minute), gain resistance 5 to electricity.

name: Starlight Armor
effects: For 1 minute (once per day): resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning and slashing damage, increasing to 10 at 17th level. (The dazzling save for adjacent attackers is target-facing.)
